description: Congestion event with its own delay figure and berth time.
subject: Congestion Alert - Port of Singapore
body:
Dear Owners,

Please be advised that the Port of Singapore (SGSIN) is currently experiencing severe congestion. Vessels including MV Cycladic Wind should expect a delay of 18 hours before berthing. Updated berth time: 2026-11-26 09:30 UTC.

Regards,
Singapore Port Services
